_comment: Deterministic skeleton for BUILD_AGENT_RESULT.json. The builder agent MUST copy this file verbatim into the per-run scratch path, then fill in the values. Every required field name, casing, enum value, and JSON type is part of the contract. The deterministic build finalizer refuses any agent result that does not validate against this shape.
_field_contract: summary/notes are strings; evidence is an object; blocker_reason/escalation_reason are string-or-null; escalation_recommended is a JSON boolean; unit_ids_completed/acceptance_addressed are arrays of non-empty strings.
work_unit_id: <fill: e.g. UNIT-1 — must match a work unit in the approved packet>
_outcome_requested_enum: Must be exactly one of: candidate_ready | blocked | stopped — lowercase, underscore, no quotes mismatch.
summary: <fill: one-paragraph plain text summary of what was done and what the validators said>

evidence.pytest_offline_summary: <fill: last lines of pytest output, plain text>

notes: <fill: anything the reviewer/finalizer should know that is not visible from the diff>
